Team,

Quick summary: we need final decisions on which returning interns we can extend full-time offers to, and signoff on the comp bands for the new grad conversions. Key asks (please reply with clear yes/no or a specific number by EOD Thursday):

- Headcount: Can your team convert the following slots to FT? (see attached sheet)
  - Core Serving: 4
  - Console: 2
  - Platform: 3
- Comp bands: attached is comp-band-proposal-v2.pdf with recommended bands and examples from market comp. Approve or suggest a delta (in $k) and whether to allow one-time signing adjustments.
- Priority: If you must reduce conversions, indicate which roles we should prioritize (infra, back-end, front-end, data infra).

Notes:
- We have two strong returners flagged by CS for client-facing roles (Jared from Acme.ai and Priya from CampusRECRUIT references) — those may require a +5k signing uplift.
- If teams decline slots, we will reallocate to other product teams or keep as contractor hires.

Attachments: 2027_intern_capacity_sheet.xlsx (Excel), comp-band-proposal-v2.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Sr. Engineering Manager, Talent Planning
